info.title: Riverside Library: notes on every kind of node

tags.name: Lending
x-notes: TAG. Every lending operation is refused while the branch is closed.
OPERATION. A returned loan stays readable here for ninety days.

parameters.name: loanId
x-notes: PARAMETER OBJECT. Loan ids are not reused, but they are not sequential either.
PARAMETER SCHEMA. Twelve characters, always, including the two letter branch prefix.
RESPONSE OBJECT. The body is returned even when the loan has been written off.
COMPONENT SCHEMA. Loans of periodicals carry no dueOn: they are reference only.
SCHEMA PROPERTY. Always a date, never a date-time. The service has no concept of a due hour.
